terra.problem: Joshua 12:24 lists the king of Tirzah but does not itself say he was defeated. Add Joshua 12:7 to the passage reference.
The Baasha moment says he reigned in Tirzah for twenty-four years, but 1 Kings 15:21 does not say this. Add 1 Kings 15:33 to the passage reference.
Words such as “fortifying,” “conspired,” and “besieged” may be difficult at a fifth-grade reading level. Use simpler wording, such as “strengthening,” “plotted,” and “surrounded.”
